changes.title: Bedroom version
items: The bedroom shows which version you're playing, small in its top left corner

changes.title: Snow leopard
items: A new kind of area for the high glaciers' island, the icefall: glacier ice and old snow, cairns and leaning standing stones, stunted pines, rowan and dwarf birch in the lee of the rocks

The snow leopard, a new creature for it: a long, low, pale smoky cat with an enormously long, thick ringed tail, that leaps on you from afar; its legend is the elder of the snow leopards, its long ringed tail worn round its shoulders like a stole, and its gift is Ghost of the peaks (a longer blink, and sharper turns in the treetops)

changes.title: Rig hocks
items: On the ground, four-legged creatures' legs bend where their species' do: a deer's hock high and sharp over an upright cannon, a bear's flat foot, a wolf's wrist, following the creature art instead of one guessed bend for all

changes.title: Rhino
items: A new creature, the rhino, with its own area, the bushveld (close thorn scrub on red earth): a grey hulk with a great horn on its nose that lowers its head and charges. Its legend is an elder with one colossal horn ringed in bronze offerings, a hide in heavy armour folds and old scars, and sleeps sunk in the red earth like a boulder; its gift is Rhino's Charge (much faster on the ground, slower to get going). It lives on a later island, out to the south

changes.title: Polarbear
items: A new creature, the polar bear, with its own area, the pack ice: white floes split by black water, a pressure ridge in the middle, wind-bent firs on the shore. It pounces from out of reach. Its legend has a vast shaggy coat streaming back off it, frost on its muzzle, and sleeps sunk in the ice like a drift of old snow; its gift is Polar bear's Blizzard (💌s fly further and land more easily). It lives on a later island, out to the north

changes.title: Ibex
items: A new kind of area for the north-east's mountain island, the crags: lichened rock and glacier ice, rock spires, wind-bent larch and gnarled wild olives, broom, juniper and heather among the stones, and a heap of glacier rubble

The ibex, a new creature for it: a stocky wild goat whose horns grow from nothing on the kid to great knobbled scimitars, that backs off and charges like the ram; its legend is the peaks' oldest ibex, its horns grown vast and knobbled, a long beard, lichen on its flanks and stone beads round its legs, and its gift is Ibex's Sure-footed (quicker starts on foot, and a quicker climb to the treetops)

changes.title: Frost troll
items: A new kind of area for the frozen north's island, the trollwood: weeping birch hung with frost and dark pines in stands, an iced stream, and snow-capped boulders that might be sleeping trolls

The frost troll, a new creature for it: a hunched, shaggy troll with big round eyes, a rosy bulb of a nose and a white beard, knuckling along on its long arms, slow but hard-hitting; its legend is the oldest troll, half turned to stone from its feet up, beads round its neck, and its gift is Frost troll's Long stride (quicker on foot, and a quicker climb to the treetops)

changes.title: Elder kit
items: Legends can show their age and their standing now: a grey muzzle and brows, an ear bitten in some old fight, a tusk or horn broken short, a bronze torc, rings on horns and tusks, earrings, cuffs on their legs, little bells. The ram's horns are ringed, a bell at each tip; the shrine fox has rings in its ears and a bell at its throat

changes.title: Crocodile
items: A new creature, the crocodile, with its own area, the mangrove swamp: long, low and toothy, it lies in wait and lunges when you come close. Its legend sleeps in the mud like a log, a ridge of standing stones down its back, and its gift is Crocodile's Snap (your blink comes back quicker). It lives on a later island, out to the south-west

changes.title: Creature torso
items: Four-legged creatures have a frame under their coats now: withers over the shoulders, a pelvis at the rump, a dip between, a deep chest in front of the forelegs, and a neck with a nape and a throat, so the head hangs from the neck instead of being skewered on it

changes.title: Creature spine
items: Animals can have a spine of their own along the back, from a crest to a groove: the big cats and the wolf carry a groove between their back muscles, the stag and elk a shoulder line, the boar a bristled crest

changes.title: Creature legs
items: Four-legged creatures have real legs now: an elbow and a wrist in front, a stifle and a hock behind, each kind standing its own way (deer and boar up on slim cannons and hooves, cats and dogs on their toes, bears and badgers flat-footed, newts sprawling), with paws and hooves in place of balls

changes.title: Creature heads
items: Four-legged creatures' faces have bones now: a brow over the eyes, cheeks, a lower jaw with a mouth, and whiskers on the ones that have them, so a lynx reads as a cat and a bear as a bear from the front

changes.title: Creature girth
items: Animals are no longer sausages: a body can have a deep, wide chest and a slim waist (its width and depth set apart along its length). The big cats, the wolf, fox and fennec, and the stag, roe and elk have theirs

changes.title: Arctic fox
items: A new kind of area for the cold north's island, the snowfield: deep snow under snow-laden firs and dwarf birch, and a ring of old stones half buried in a drift

The arctic fox, a new creature for it: a small white fox with a huge brush that leaps on you like a fox mousing in the snow; its legend is the oldest of the white foxes, shaggy and frost-muzzled, with one vast tufted brush and stone beads round its legs, and its gift is Arctic fox's Snow pounce (a longer blink, and quicker starts on foot)

changes.title: Zoo controls
items: In the zoo: a nameplate under every block (its creature, its area, the area's line and its legend's boon), a bar for the block you're in to add or remove creatures at any level, set them calm, wild, happy or angry, and put them to sleep, and a list (J) to jump to any block; a Zoo button in the bedroom
